items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of J.C. Higginbotham interacting with or knowing Jack Christy. The mention of Jack Christy is in an [INTERVIEWER] turn describing a location ('Jack Christy's place') and a plaque, with no response from the interviewee confirming any personal connection.

ctx.x: After you came back to New York from Boston, what were you doing in New York?
I did a few gigs down to Jack Christy's place, you know.
Second Avenue, Central Plaz a on Second Avenue. He's got a plaque back there that Jack gave him.
